detail.description: 奏 calls 小春 'こはるん' → 'Koharun' (nickname listed as alias)
奏 calls 源之助 'ゲンちゃん' → 'Gen-chan' (nickname)
湊 says 'うちの部' = 'our club' (not a first-person pronoun)
校長先生 → 'the principal' (a title, not name+honorific; keep policy does not apply)
湊 (plain) speaks polite to a teacher: 'わかってますよ、先生' — natural register shift
奏 (Kansai) EN uses 'gonna' / 'y'know' — allowed for her (avoid-list belongs to other characters)
'chronograph' used generically for a wristwatch, lower-case, next to the proper 'the Chronograph'
黒羽 quotes Crow's card 『僕は約束を守る』 — 僕 is inside a quotation
小春 quotes 『僕』 — meta-mention of the pronoun
奏 mentions 『俺』 — meta-mention of the pronoun
部室棟 (club building) contains 部室 but is a different word; 'clubroom' is correctly absent
詩織's polite speech intentionally breaks (scene marks it in s6_022); EN keeps no contractions
小春 calls 湊 without 先輩, marked by narration s6_030; EN 'Minato!' matches
'Q.E.D.' identical in JA and EN — intentional
小春 quotes 源之助's line 『拙者が…』 — 拙者 inside a quotation
詩織 slips to 湊さん then corrects to 朝霧さん; marked by narration s7_009; EN mirrors it
{1}個の{0} → 'Obtained {0} ×{1}' — reordered, same placeholder set
'Return to Title' is exactly max_length 15
